metaDescription: White-label WordPress website for Klinik am Schwarzwald, a German plastic surgery clinic: treatment menus, doctors, careers, financing and booking forms.
summary: German-language WordPress website for a plastic and aesthetic surgery clinic.
overview: Klinik am Schwarzwald is a plastic and aesthetic surgery clinic in Lauchringen, Germany, near the Swiss border, led by Dr. Mario Holdenried. Pixel2Tech built the clinic's German-language WordPress website as white-label development partner for a digital agency. The site organizes a wide treatment list and makes it simple for patients to ask for a consultation.
challenge: The clinic offers dozens of surgical and non-surgical treatments across breast, face, body and skin, and each needs its own page. Patients also come with different first questions, such as price, a photo assessment or a video call, so one generic contact form was not enough.
approach: A dark green header carries Behandlungen (treatments), Ärzte (doctors), Klinik, Karriere (careers), Finanzierung (financing), an Ästhetik+ magazine, Kontakt, site search and a Beratung vereinbaren (book a consultation) button. The treatments menu opens into breast, face, body and skin columns with featured procedures on top. Slide-out panels hold separate forms for booking an appointment, sending photos, requesting a video consultation and asking for a price, with GDPR consent on each.
outcome: A clinic website where patients can find a treatment in a couple of clicks, read about the doctors and team, check financing and send the exact request they have in mind. On phones a fixed Kontakt & Anfrage bar keeps the request forms within reach.
deliverables: WordPress website on a custom theme
Treatment mega menu by body area
Booking, photo, video and price request forms
Mobile layout with fixed contact bar

process.title: Treatment structure
process.body: Treatments are grouped into breast, face, body and skin, each with its own URL path, so patients and search engines can follow a clear hierarchy from category to procedure.

process.title: Clinic and team
process.body: The home page shows the full team photo, a personal message from Dr. Holdenried, the most requested treatments, a short video, patient reviews and a team introduction, with doctors, clinic and careers pages in the main menu.

process.title: Consultation requests
process.body: Four slide-out forms cover appointment booking, photo requests, video consultations and price requests, the last with a dropdown of treatments grouped by area.

process.title: Mobile and compliance
process.body: On phones the menu and search sit beside the logo and a fixed bar opens the request forms, while Borlabs Cookie handles consent and the footer links to imprint, privacy and accessibility pages.

whyItMatters: Patients considering an aesthetic procedure want clear information and a low-pressure way to ask questions first. Separate request paths for price, photos and video calls let them start the conversation the way they feel comfortable.

faqs.q: What is the Klinik am Schwarzwald website built with?
faqs.a: It runs on WordPress with a custom theme and the block editor, using Borlabs Cookie for consent management and Yoast SEO for search settings.

faqs.q: Do you work white-label for agencies?
faqs.a: Yes. We build websites and Shopify stores under the agency's brand, with an NDA when needed. Tell us about the project and we will send a fixed quote after a short call.
